svg.title: Pink Rooster superhero shield
svg.desc: A crested pink rooster with a burgundy domino mask, ivory eyes and throat, golden beak and P badge, and a billowing plum cape over a pink shield.
svg.metadata: Reconstructed from the 512 × 512 RGBA source using native closed Bézier paths and fitted vector gradients. The connected burgundy silhouette supplies shared shield, cape, neck and head outlines.
